prompt: Build Charizard from Pokemon — the fully-evolved orange dragon Pokemon. Unmistakable features: (1) bright ORANGE bipedal dragon body with a long snake-like neck and big head, (2) huge BLUE-GREEN bat-like WINGS spread wide behind it (the inner wing membranes are teal/blue-green, contrasting the orange body), (3) a long thick tail with a bright burning FLAME at the tip (orange/yellow fire), (4) a CREAM/TAN coloured belly and inner-wing tone, (5) two small horns curving back from the head, (6) sharp claws on hands and feet, (7) confident pose with chest forward and wings spread, breathing slightly upward as if about to roar. Use BRICK for the bright orange body (head, neck, torso, arms, tail), SAND or PLANKS for the cream-tan belly and inner-mouth highlights, ICE or GLASS for the blue-green inner wing membranes (teal/cyan), OAK_LOG for darker orange shadow accents and claws, LEAVES for the wing accents (greenish tint), BRICK and SAND mixed for the bright flame on the tail tip. Pose Charizard facing the viewer with wings spread wide and tail flame clearly burning. Wings spread + tail flame are the unmistakable identifier. Make it imposing and unmistakably Charizard.
